name: Stormbringer: Enveloping Winds echoes Gale on the Air Elemental (#483)
contract: #483 Enveloping Winds (707546) promises two things: a raid armor aura and 'casting Gale now causes your Air Elemental to cast Gale'. The armor clause is native and is asserted as a baseline: effect 1 is a SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL with EffectAmplitude 5000 that casts 707547, a SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID / SPELL_AURA_MOD_RESISTANCE with EffectMiscValue[0] = 1 (armor) over SpellRadius index 12 (100 yd). Its amount is level-scaled: EffectBasePoints[0] = 389, EffectDieSides[0] = 1 (always +1, per SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue's DieSides == 1 case), and EffectRealPointsPerLevel[0] = 25.0 above BaseLevel/SpellLevel 30 (SpellInfo.cpp:468-505), so at the caster's level 80 the value is 389 + (80 - 30) * 25 + 1 = 1640 armor, not the flat 390 the DBC base row alone suggests. The echo clause has no delivery at all: effect 0 is a bare SPELL_AURA_DUMMY whose EffectTriggerSpell is the armor aura, 707546 ships ProcFlags = 0, and no Enveloping Winds record carries a SPELL_EFFECT_FORCE_CAST sibling. The fix adds a proc entry keyed on Gale's own identity (family 22, SpellFamilyFlags[0] = 0x4000) and aura_ascension_enveloping_winds, which makes the Air Elemental repeat the exact rank the Stormbringer cast.

steps.label: Let spawn and level scaling settle
SETUP: the Air Elemental (creature 500941) is out
BASELINE: the grouped ally carries no 707547 raid aura
Let the baseline Gale land and any echo resolve
BASELINE: without Enveloping Winds the Air Elemental casts no Gale
BASELINE CLAUSE A: the 5 s periodic tick puts 707547 on the grouped ally
BASELINE CLAUSE A: the ally gains exactly 1640 armor (707547 EffectBasePoints[0] = 389, EffectDieSides[0] = 1, EffectRealPointsPerLevel[0] = 25 above BaseLevel 30, at caster level 80)
Global cooldown before the measured Gale
DISCRIMINATING CLAUSE B: the Air Elemental repeats Gale once
The raid armor aura is untouched by the echo
